key_findings: Combined ST36+GB30 electroacupuncture gives stronger analgesia than ST36 alone in CCI and inhibits spinal vGlut2 neuron synaptic transmission more.
Only combined EA activates spinal endocannabinoid system (AEA, 2-AG, CB1, CB2); blocking CB receptors plus opioid receptors abolishes its effect.
